steps.text: Enter the Mourners' headquarters in the north-eastern corner of West Ardougne.
Continue talking to the Head Mourner.
Climb up ladder to the south.
Climb down the staircase to the north.

actions.text: Try to chisel a shard off the crystal.

steps.text: Use the blackened crystal on Eluned.

steps.title: Temple of Light
steps.text: Go back to the Temple of Light.
Tie a rope to the rock.
Pull the crystal collector lever to reset the puzzle.

Collect with the crystal collector.
  • Drop your new key if you need inventory space.

Cross the gap to the other side.
  • Use any agility boosts you have.
Reset the puzzle at the crystal dispenser and collect all items.
Climb up the ladder to the south.
Mirror #7 points down (big mirror side east).
Climb down the ladder to the south.
Pass through the light door to the north-west.
Climb up the ladder to the south.
Rotate Mirror #7 south. This light should be red.
Mirror #8 point downs (big mirror side north).
Climb down the ladder to the south.
Reset the puzzle at the crystal dispenser and collect all items.

Cross the gap to the other side.
  • Use any agility boosts you have.
Climb up the ladder to the south.
Mirror #5 points down (big mirror side east).
Mirror #7 points down (big mirror side west).
Climb down the ladder to the south.
Reset the puzzle at the crystal dispenser and collect all items.
Mirror #2 points down (big mirror side south)
Place the fractured crystal to the south.
Place the yellow crystal to the north.
Climb up the ladder to the south.
Go through to the death altar.

Retrieve the items Thorgel wants.
  • Rotate Mirror #14 east UNLESS you go through the Underground Pass to return to the Death Altar.
  • To enter from the Underground Pass side, enter the underground pass from Tirannwn, make your way to the Dwarven Camp, and enter the tunnel behind the camp.

actions.text: I've got some of them with me.

steps.text: Use the newly made crystal on the altar.
Exit through the portal. DO NOT TELEPORT OUT.
Use the powered newly made crystal on the black crystal.
